dct_title_s: Preliminary Satellite-derived Flood Impact Assessment, North Santo Antao Island, Cabo Verde
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250812CPV** Status: No major damage was observed Further action(s): Continue monitoring Summary of findings: No major damage was observed in Ponta do Sol Town, Cruzinha Village, and Ribeira da Cruz Village in northern Santo Antão Island as of 16 August 2025. Possible flood evidence was observed along the waterways in Ribeira Grande Town and Coculi Town in northern Santo Antão Island as of 16 August 2025.
